newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA shares fall after flat results.
newsitem.headline: SIA shares fall after flat results.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd shares fell in early trading on Monday after the group announced flat 1997 results, dealers said.
At 0225 GMT, SIA shares were down 15 cents to Singapore $7.35 on light volume of 11,000 while the foreign tranche was down 50 cents to S$12.80 with 679,000 units traded.
"SIA's results were disappointing. Their earnings were boosted by aircraft sales. It seems that is what they do each time to keep their profit up," said a broker with a Singapore firm.
He said some investors could also be liquidating their positions in disappointment that the company did not announce a bonus issue to celebrate its 50th anniversary this year.
SIA announced a bonus dividend of 7.5 percent instead as the airline posted a 0.6 percent rise in net profit to S$1,032 million on Friday.

The company said the airline's operating profits were affected by high fuel costs, competition and a strong Singapore dollar. But the surplus from the sales of used aircraft helped boost the bottom line.
